rectFormat: [x,y,width,height], pixels in original 1536x1024 PNG; right and bottom are exclusive
alphaBoundsDefinition: Exact nonzero alpha within the nominal cell, threshold alpha>=1; may include faint edge halos and may clip a sprite crossing the nominal cell
visibleSpriteBoundsDefinition: Combined bounds of 8-connected alpha>=16 components (at least 8 pixels) assigned by component centroid to nominal cell; can extend beyond that cell and retain an entire sprite
recommendedCropDefinition: visibleSpriteBounds expanded 3 pixels on all sides, clamped to image; use for drawImage source rectangles; never resave or edit the PNG
visualNotes: The PNG RGB channels retain a colorful generated gradient under fully transparent pixels; interior background samples are alpha 0.
